verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents custom schemas for extracting structured JSON from repetitive page patterns, plus CSS, XPath and LLM-driven structured extraction. The CLI also supports query-driven extraction such as product prices. missing for 10: in-depth docs showing the JSON result shape and how it is accessed (e.g. on the crawl result object or as a JSON CLI output flag), and independent hands-on corroboration of structured JSON output.
